verdicts.reason: A: 'Every mixed case.' is squeezed into a narrow column and wraps awkwardly onto three lines next to the CTA. The legal line is crammed under the button and too small to read, and the shoe sits low and off-centre in a large empty circle, so the bottom is jammed while the middle is dead space.
